title: State-change coalescing: Scene SceneAvatar mutations may overwhelm Chat-only clients
description: Scene recommends 1-5 second coalescing windows for SceneAvatar StateChange events due to periodic position reconciliation. Chat has no corresponding coalescing recommendation and implies immediate StateChange delivery. Co-deployed servers sharing a single StateChange payload will generate much higher event rates than Chat-only clients expect. Need coalescing guidance in the co-deployment section.
